g.text: Main-arm outcomes and legitimate task performance
Descriptive summaries only. Each arm: 16 sessions × 4 rounds. Controls are separate.
Reviewer liability is 25% of the peer's excess; owner net loss is 75% of total excess. No causal effect of adding liability was tested.
